result.topic_en: A quadrature problem: choosing nodes alpha_i so that an approximation of the integral of f from 0 to 1, exact for trigonometric combinations up to order n, is also exact for sin(n+1)x, cos(n+1)x, ..., by analogy with Gauss and Jacobi quadrature for polynomials.
